The animal has brown dorsal fur and creamy-yellow ventral fur. It is facing left, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. The background is a blurred mix of grey and green, suggesting a natural outdoor setting.

The eye is visible, appearing small, dark, and round, consistent with the species description.
The ear is visible on the top of the head; it is short, rounded, and blends into the fur, matching the taxonomy.

The transition from the body to the tail and the rear leg is somewhat indistinct. The geometry of the haunches feels slightly 'mushy' or undefined compared to the sharper front half. It is unclear if the rear leg is tucked or missing due to the angle.
